reference_audio.note: Optional: omit it (and `reference_text`) to use the model's own default voice -- there is no preset or voice-design mode.  For cloning, `reference_text` (the clip's exact transcript) is mandatory: the processor refuses a clip without it, so half a pair is a 422.  3--10 s of clean, single-speaker audio works best.  Nothing is truncated: each second of clip occupies ~21.5 of the model's 2048 context positions, which is why clips over 20 s are refused outright -- and why a clip whose container length cannot be measured (an MP3 with no Xing/Info/VBRI table) is refused too, rather than decoded down to whatever a bitrate guess happens to land on.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to synthesize, e.g. 'Hello there'.  The model's 2048 position context is shared with the reference clip, hence the hard cap.  For best prosody keep it under ~150 characters and split longer passages into separate requests.

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice clip (3--10 s works well) as a base64 string, for zero-shot cloning.  Must be sent together with `reference_text` -- the engine refuses a clip without its exact transcript.  Omit both to use the model's own default voice.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...); any rate (resampled to 44.1 kHz server-side).  An MP3 must carry a length table (Xing/Info/VBRI): without one a decoder can only guess the duration and stops at the guess, so such a clip is refused (400) instead of being used in pieces.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference clip.  Required whenever `audio_base64` is present, and rejected without it -- the pairing is a client contract, not a mode switch.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en' or 'th'.  Accepted for API consistency but not forwarded -- the engine has no language parameter and detects the language from the input text (Realistic Air covers 23 languages).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: max_new_tokens
parameters.description: Generation budget in audio frames (one frame = 2048 codec samples, ~21.5 per second of audio), so 1024 is ~47 s.  The model clamps this to the 2048-position context minus the prompt, so a long text/clip shortens it.  A prompt that leaves under 256 frames over is refused (400) rather than answered with a single frame of audio.

parameters.name: retry_max_new_tokens
parameters.description: If the first pass hits its frame budget without emitting an end of speech token, retry once with this larger budget (the engine CLI's own default).  Setting it equal to `max_new_tokens` disables the retry; anything smaller is rejected (422).  Both budgets are clamped to what the prompt leaves over out of 2048 positions, so a wide prompt disables the retry on its own -- a second pass could not add a frame.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature (engine CLI default 0.8; the checkpoint's generation_config suggests 0.7).  The engine only enforces that it is positive.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Top-k candidate count (engine CLI default).  Must be positive -- the engine's own filter rejects 0 -- and values above the 4096 entry semantic codebook are a no-op, so the schema stops there.

parameters.name: greedy
parameters.description: Argmax decoding instead of sampling.  Deterministic regardless of seed, and noticeably flatter in prosody.
